name: Purgatory

abilityDetails.Armor Break: Düşmanın zırh korumasını kırarak hasar alımını artırır.
abilityDetails.Power Steal: Hedefin gücünü azaltıp aynı miktarı kendine kazandırır.
abilityDetails.Slow: Düşmanın Durdurulamaz (Unstoppable) ve Kaçış (Evade) yeteneklerini iptal eder.
abilityDetails.Neutralize: Buff yetenek doğruluğunu belirtilen güçte azaltır.
abilityDetails.Cross-Fight Ability: Saldıran veya savunan şampiyona uygulanabilen ve bir görev içinde birden fazla dövüş boyunca süren yetenek.
abilityDetails.Power Gain: Güç barlarını anlık veya zamanla doldurur.
abilityDetails.Incinerate: Zamanla enerji tabanlı yakma hasarı verir ve zırhı yok sayar.
abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.
abilityDetails.Degeneration: Rakibe zamanla doğrudan, engellenemez hasar verir.

signatureAbility:
Eternal Damnation
If the Opponent is Knocked Out while Demonic Rampage is active, their soul is instantly Captured.
The duration of Class Soul Abilities are increased by +[10 - 35]%.
immunityDetails:
• Yakma Bağışıklığı 🔥
• Kanama Bağışıklığı (ile sinerji: Hood) 🩸

abilitySections.title: Always Active
content: Purgatory's demonic nature provides Immunity to Incinerate and causes all attacks to deal Energy Damage instead of Physical.
Combat Power Rate is decreased by 40%.

abilitySections.title: Class Soul Abilities
content: Purgatory gains additional abilities depending on the Opponent's Class.
Mystic Soul: When the Opponent launches a Special Attack, gain a 60% Block Regeneration Passive for 6 seconds.
Cosmic Soul: When filling a Bar of Power, Nullify 1 of the Opponent's Buffs. Whenever an Opponent's Buff is Nullified or prevented with Neutralize, gain an Unblockable Buff for 2 seconds.
Tech Soul: When filling a Bar of Power, inflict an Armor Break Debuff, reducing Armor Rating by [1,069.44] for 9 seconds.
Mutant Soul: At the end of the Opponent's Special Attacks, Power Steal 40% of their remaining Power, gaining 150% of the Power Stolen over 4 seconds.
Skill Soul: When a personal Debuff on the Opponent ends or is prevented from activating, inflict a Slow Passive for 12 seconds.
Science Soul: A chemically-tainted soul cannot be stolen.

abilitySections.title: Soul Neutralize - Cross-Fight Soul Capture
content: As Purgatory gains Power, the Bloodline sword steals the soul from the Opponent's body, inflicting Soul Neutralize, which counts as an indefinite, 10% Neutralize Passive. Max stacks: 10.
Soul Neutralize is not affected by Ability Accuracy.
Inflict 1 Soul Neutralize at the start of each fight and when filling a Bar of Power. As a Defender, inflict 2 each time.
At 10 Soul Neutralizes, the Opponent's soul is Captured, granting their Class Soul Ability for the remainder of the Quest.

abilitySections.title: Champion Attacks - Bloodthirst - Max: 100
content: When either Champion lands a Basic Attack or performs a Well-Timed Block, gain 5 Bloodthirst.
Purgatory loses 5 Bloodthirst if she goes 4 seconds without increasing her Bloodthirst. This timer is paused during any Special Attack and expires 20% slower for each Buff on the Opponent.
Gaining Bloodthirst Passively grants up to 9% of a Bar of Power based on current Bloodthirst over 1.5 seconds.
At 100 Bloodthirst, enter Demonic Rampage.

abilitySections.title: Demonic Rampage - Bloodthirst Locked to 100
content: For 15 seconds, Purgatory gains +[9,855.2] Attack Rating and her Special Attacks gain Rampage enhancements.
Demonic Rampage is paused during all Special Attacks and for 3 seconds each time Purgatory fills a Bar of Power.
Striking with a Medium Combo-Ender consumes 50% of a Bar of Purgatory's Power to inflict an Incinerate Debuff, dealing [11,087.1] Energy Damage over 4 seconds.
When Demonic Rampage ends, reset Bloodthirst to 0.

abilitySections.title: Special Attacks
content: If the Opponent is Knocked Out, their soul is instantly Captured.
Rampage: Gain a Fury Buff granting +[9,855.2] Attack Rating for 6 seconds, paused during Special Attacks.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: On Activation, gain 25 Bloodthirst.
Rampage: Each hit Passively Regenerates 15% of the damage dealt.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: The last hit inflicts a Degeneration Debuff, dealing [33,261.3] Direct Damage over 6 second(s).
Rampage: This attack is Passively Unblockable.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Gain a non-stacking Power Gain Buff, granting 3 Bars of Power over 35 seconds.
Rampage or if the Opponent's soul is Captured: This attack ignores Armor and deals additional damage equal to 4% of the Opponent's Max Health. The additional damage cannot be increased.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Eternal Damnation
content: If the Opponent is Knocked Out while Demonic Rampage is active, their soul is instantly Captured.
The duration of Class Soul Abilities are increased by +[10 - 35]%.
